reasons: A separate, explicit expression-source profile is an appropriate component toward the compact TypeScript-style DSL.
Preserving old entry points, accepted bytes and semantics prevents silent migration.
This approves profile separation only. Parser, formatter and runtime compatibility remain unverified.
Explicit widths, signed literals, nominal indices, scales, options and collection capacities fit the baseline exact-type model without a host type-alias registry.
Quantity<Units<USD,1,EUR,-1>,2> contradicts increasing ASCII identifier order and baseline unitDomain. Correct spelling is Quantity<Units<EUR,-1,USD,1>,2>.
This is a bounded specification/example defect, not a fundamental problem with dimensional types. It nevertheless prevents approval of these exact proposal bytes.

The normative source type contract should explicitly inherit all baseline domains, including eight-unit maximum, scale 0..18, distinct Price assets, UInt128 Price mantissas, collection capacity 0..128 and exclusion of Unit as a value type.
The fixed generic-name rule resolves ordinary generic/comparison ambiguity, and preserving lexical record and collection order is correct.
The mapping table reaches all 40 constructor names, but does not establish representability of their full admitted operand domains.
Inherited call arity 64 prevents collection constructors with 65..128 elements.
Core Emit accepts any expression of the required Record type. The proposed emission syntax always inserts ConstructRecord, so it cannot preserve arbitrary Emit operands, work or diagnostic paths.
Reserved-name and namespace rules are incomplete. Core permits identifiers that source keywords or fixed generic primaries make unreachable.
The grammar adds index brackets without an explicit lexical punctuation delta.
Trusted immutable Sigma, runtime-validated snapshots, rejection of direct financial writes and the ExpressionPrepared label are appropriate boundaries.
The one-action bridge is explicitly a component; retaining full eventual SP02, financial semantics, K, proof and Preview obligations is essential.
The assertion that every reviewed expression is expressible is too strong given collection limits, emission operands, reserved identifiers and the inherited 64-parameter limit.
Optional asset declarations have no defined consistency predicate: baseline Sigma stores asset names but no asset-to-unit mapping.
Unknown-action checking also needs an explicit source action-selection contract; baseline Sigma contains no action-name registry.
Whole-action checking, UTF-8 spans, original Core paths and rejection without tentative results are sound requirements.
The listed pass-through errors omit VALUE_BOUND and DESCRIPTOR_BOUND, both observable baseline failures.
Source error precedence relative to structural input admission and typed snapshot validation is insufficiently specified.
The proposal needs an explicit conservative work calculation over lowered Core, including inserted nodes and skipped Boolean branches.
Span ownership and diagnostic paths for inserted Emit/ConstructRecord nodes, metadata errors and action-finalization failures remain unspecified.

requiredCorrections.correction: Replace the unsorted Quantity example with Quantity<Units<EUR,-1,USD,1>,2>. Retain rejection of unsorted, duplicate, zero-exponent and out-of-domain unit vectors; do not silently normalize source metadata. State that ordering is ASCII identifier order.

Distinguish constructor-name coverage from full operand-domain and composition coverage. Give /1 collection construction an explicit 128-element bound while preserving old-profile limits. Resolve the 64-parameter versus Sigma.args capacity mismatch. Define the exact source-admissible schema/domain instead of claiming unrestricted Core representability.

Provide source syntax that lowers Emit with an arbitrary Record-valued operand directly, while retaining the braced record sugar. For example, specify an expression-bearing emission form. Emit(O,ReadArg(r)) costs two entered nodes; reconstructing a one-field record as emit O { f:r.f } costs four and changes paths. Do not call that reconstruction exact correspondence.

Publish a namespace and reserved-name matrix covering lexical keywords, pre/post/obs/next, all intrinsics, type constructors, enum names, metadata identifiers, parameters and locals. Specify collisions, shadowing and projection resolution. Address a valid Core enum named some, keyword-named fields such as state, and parameters named pre. Either provide explicit source spellings or declare and validate the restricted source domain; do not silently rename trusted identities.

Complete the /1 lexical and grammar delta: add bracket tokens with profile behavior, preserve nested-generic closing and >= splitting rules, and enumerate intrinsic metadata arities and roles. Clarify that record<R> takes a bare record identifier despite the broader EBNF type production. Specify rejection of nested types where bare asset, vault, holder or nominal identifiers are required.

Define exact consistency checks for optional declarations. Baseline asset Cash: Asset<USD> carries a relation absent from Sigma.assets; either bind that relation through an explicit trusted contract or reject/defer the declaration form. Define action-name selection separately from Sigma.args. Preserve full declarations and financial bindings as eventual SP02 work, without introducing a hidden type-alias registry or public Core-input substitute.

Specify ownership at the source API boundary: bind an immutable trusted schema, own snapshot data before checking/use, prevent caller mutation between checking and evaluation, and prevent returned values from altering later evaluations. Static checking must not execute the action. Retain immutable pre/args/observations, sequential immutable locals, post only in ensures, financial write rejection and complete rollback.

Publish the complete failure-phase contract. Distinguish structural envelope admission, source elaboration, Core/schema checking, typed snapshot validation and reduction. Preserve VALUE_BOUND and DESCRIPTOR_BOUND as well as the listed errors. Specify deterministic precedence, workUsed=0 before reduction, and exact source spans/Core paths for inserted nodes, duplicate fields, metadata and final aggregate failures.

Define conservative work B from the lowered Core occurrence tree, counting both Boolean branches, Not(Eq(...)) for !=, and every emitted record constructor. Distinguish the registered static ceiling from request workInitial; do not invent a requirement that every request fund all unselected branches. Preserve runtime exhaustion location and charge semantics.

constructorInventory.assessment: All 40 names have proposed mappings; full admitted-domain representability is not established.

inertCalculations: A 65-element UInt64 collection witness uses 562 source bytes, 7734 canonical Core bytes and 67 constructor nodes; inherited call arity 64 is the limiting mismatch.
A 128-element witness uses 1003 source bytes, 14916 canonical Core bytes and 130 constructor nodes.
A 65-argument UInt64 schema occupies 1231 canonical bytes and 65 declarations, while the source parameter limit is 64.
ASCII sorting places EUR before USD.

limits: Independent design votes only. No implementation approval, second-reviewer vote or consensus is asserted.
No delegation, repository edits, private-data access, financial/proof/service execution or network acquisition occurred.
No candidate parser, evaluator, formatter, build or test suite was executed. Inert witness calculations are not parser or runtime reproductions.

Required verification remains specified-only: real-source all40 cases; numeric extrema and overflow; scale/unit boundaries; collection lengths 0/64/65/128/129; exact capacity equality; nested options and records; namespace collisions; generic/comparison parsing; Unicode spans; error precedence; work; snapshot ownership; rollback; and old-profile compatibility.
Operation values can be read through typed inputs; this inventory has no general Operation-value constructor or option elimination. Source syntax does not add missing Core semantics.

Price remains unsigned and base-per-quote; indexing requires UInt64; implicit width, asset, scale or capacity conversions remain forbidden. Mixed Amount multiplication/division needed by the financial specimens remains open.
The compact braced source is directionally consistent with the requested DSL. The syntax comparison is specified-only, not an empirical usability result.

Full SP02 declarations, financial transitions, ACTUS/DeFi coverage, K correspondence, mandatory proofs and Preview financial acceptance remain open. A one-action ExpressionPrepared bridge satisfies none of those acceptance gates by itself.
